summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with flank pain, fever, and dark, cloudy urine, consistent with recurrent pyelonephritis due to a left ureteroileal conduit anastomotic stricture. He was treated with a two-week course of IV daptomycin and tobramycin, dosed safely per his chronic kidney disease. A PICC line was placed for antibiotic administration. His infection resolved, pain improved, and kidney function remained stable. Amlodipine was discontinued due to normotension, and Renagel was replaced with sevelamer. He was discharged home with follow-up appointments in urology and primary care, and instructions to monitor for recurrence of infection.
